issue: Side-wall construction not confirmed: IFC elements are named 'BRICK-INFILL' (300 mm, source facade_system 'Brick masonry infill') but carry a metallic-cladding render material
consequence if unresolved: The governing column criterion (h/300 masonry) and the preferred stability system depend on it; with lightweight cladding the lightest columns and the ranking change (report section 15)
action / information required: Confirm wall construction (masonry type/thickness/density/reinforcement) before detailed design

issue: No site investigation exists; soil scenarios G1-G3 are assumptions
consequence if unresolved: Pad sizes, founding depth, uplift resistance and the F2/F3 choice are unverified; expansive/collapsible clays reported in Harare could require deeper or piled foundations
action / information required: Trial pits (min. 6 to 3.0 m), 2 rotary/DCP boreholes or DPSH to 6 m, indicator tests, swell/collapse potential, groundwater observation, bearing recommendation

issue: Harare design gust / peak velocity pressure not confirmed (0.85 and 1.20 kPa are R2 study assumptions)
consequence if unresolved: SLS at 1.20 kPa fails S1 and S2 selected designs; uplift and holding-down scale with q_p
action / information required: Confirm code edition (SANS 10160-3:2019 or other) and Harare basic wind speed with Harare City Council and the appointed ECZ engineer

issue: Masonry restraint to column and post minor axes assumed at 3.3 m (ties/bond beams)
consequence if unresolved: With no restraint: UC305x97 util 0.93 (passes), existing UC254x73 1.65 (fails), gable posts UB533 2.6-4.6 (fail)
action / information required: Adopt UC305x97; provide 2 rows of designed restraint struts per gable for the posts (included); specify wall ties as restraints only where designed

issue: Option B gable-truss top chord 2L80x8 used as lateral-system collector reaches axial utilisation ~0.84 (S3) / 0.92 (S1) before purlin bending
consequence if unresolved: Truss chord may be under-sized once combined with bending; R2 reported 0.72 for this line
action / information required: Include lateral-system actions in Option B detailed design; consider 2L90x8 gable top chord (as interior lines)

issue: Truss bearing at y = 0.30 m is 145 mm eccentric to the column axis (y = 0.155 m) as modelled
consequence if unresolved: Adds Rv x 0.145 (~18-21 kNm) to column head; included in checks
action / information required: Detail a concentric bearing (cap plate centred) or retain eccentric moment in design

issue: North wall masonry above the 9.5 m loggia opening (x 43-52.5 m) has no transfer beam in the model
consequence if unresolved: Lines 7-9 north columns/pads carry an extra ~134-267 kN permanent load (assumed); lintel/transfer beam to be designed
action / information required: Design a transfer beam at +4.00 between lines 7-9; confirm loads

issue: Gable-truss bottom-chord heel panels buckle under uplift without restraint (eigen alpha 0.22)
consequence if unresolved: Unsafe bottom chord at gables
action / information required: Provide out-of-plane heel restraint cleat at gable lines 0 and 10 (included in study model)

issue: Gable wind posts (UB533x210x82) and their bracing were not in the R2 scope; braced posts carry 330-560 kN ULS uplift
consequence if unresolved: Foundations at braced posts are large (~3.0-3.4 m pads); cost underestimated in R2
action / information required: Optimise: widen gable bracing panels, prop west posts at the office roof (+4.42) if verified, or use designed masonry gable shear walls

issue: Longitudinal wall bracing must avoid clerestory windows; arranged as X below +9.90 with knee braces in 1.08 m piers (bays 1 and 5)
consequence if unresolved: Knee/pier detailing, masonry around bracing, visibility on inner face
action / information required: Agree bracing visibility/enclosure; detail masonry movement joints and soft packing around bracing

issue: Masonry infill tight to the steel frame will attract in-plane load before the steel bracing
consequence if unresolved: Cracking of masonry; unintended load paths
action / information required: Detail movement joints and flexible ties so the steel system governs (or design masonry as shear walls)

issue: Construction-stage uplift before masonry is built (roof clad first)
consequence if unresolved: Pads sized with walls absent (0.75 x q 1.20, assumed); if sheeting precedes walls with full design wind, pads must be larger
action / information required: Specify construction sequence or confirm temporary-condition wind with the engineer

issue: Fixed-base anchorage designed for concurrent N+M: 6-8 M24 groups exceed cone capacity without anchor reinforcement; pad depth 0.80 m set by anchorage
consequence if unresolved: Brittle anchorage failure if hairpins omitted
action / information required: Design anchor (supplementary) reinforcement to EN 1992-4 / ACI 318 ch.17 or equivalent; site inspection hold point

issue: Stair-core walls and gallery rear columns have no foundations modelled; core construction (RC or masonry) unverified
consequence if unresolved: Cores cannot be relied on for stability (not used in recommendation); missing substructure in BOQ
action / information required: Design core and gallery foundations; decide whether cores join the lateral system (S3-core variant)

issue: East-gable columns (line 10) have no concept footing in the IFC (COL-0015/0016)
consequence if unresolved: Missing substructure
action / information required: Add pads in controlled BIM update (spec J)

issue: UC356x368 (S2) not rolled in SADC; import premium 20-45 % and lead time
consequence if unresolved: S2 cost/programme risk
action / information required: Obtain supply quotations if S2 is pursued

issue: Rates are inferred: no Harare quotation for UC305x97, CHS bracing, ready-mix, rebar or holding-down bolts
consequence if unresolved: Absolute costs uncertain (P10-P90 about -8 %/+9 %); S3 vs S1 not decisive (P(S3<S1) about 0.67); S3 vs S2 about 0.9
action / information required: Tender enquiry to two or three Harare fabricators and concrete suppliers

issue: Design standards not formally confirmed for Harare (SANS 10160 / 10162-1 / 10100-1 used by analogy; Zimbabwe Model Building By-laws)
consequence if unresolved: Code basis may change factors and limits
action / information required: Confirm the design-code set and editions with the authority

issue: Rigging/equipment loads are scenarios (no AV/HVLS products selected)
consequence if unresolved: Truss and bearing reactions; future scenario checked (passes)
action / information required: Equipment schedule with weights and rated points

issue: Study model is a linear 3D frame model verified against closed-form checks; not a commercial FE package; joint flexibility and bolt slip ignored
consequence if unresolved: Forces/deflections are preliminary
action / information required: Independent 3D analysis in recognised software at detailed design; independent check

issue: Fixed bases need larger pads (S3: ~2.5-3.6 m) under the wall line; interfaces with external paving and internal raked floor
consequence if unresolved: Excavation conflicts with services and the raked slab edge
action / information required: Coordinate pad footprints with drainage and the hall floor slab edge

issue: Steel below FFL encased in concrete; corrosion category C2 assumed internally
consequence if unresolved: Corrosion at base if encasement omitted
action / information required: Confirm coating system, encasement and HD-bolt galvanising

issue: Base fixity assumed rigid in design runs
consequence if unresolved: Partial fixity raises S3 deflection and lowers base moment; see fixG2/fixG3 sensitivity
action / information required: Obtain subgrade modulus from SI; re-check fixity with rotational springs

issue: Ground conditions decide between S3 (firm ground) and S1 (poor/wet ground)
consequence if unresolved: Wrong system chosen if fixed before SI
action / information required: Hold the stability-system decision until the SI (gate G-B)
